title: Selección estilística y matices en los verbos de cambio
goal: Select with stylistic mastery among all verbs of becoming and integrate derived lexical change verbs in formal prose.
grammar: criterios de selección estilística y alternancia léxica en los verbos de devenir

items: Evaluate semantic nuances across the entire paradigm of becoming verbs.
Integrate synthetic derived verbs (enrojecer, empobrecerse, ensombrecer) for concision.
Produce balanced and nuanced analytical prose following CEFR B2 house style.
